name: ceramics-webapp

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Backend API for catalog browsing/search, cart management, checkout, order history, and (for administrators) product catalog management.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder OIDC sign-in for shoppers and administrators; drives the SPA's sign-in flow and the caller's role-based UI.

description: React SPA storefront for handmade ceramics: product catalog browsing/search, cart, checkout, order confirmation and history for shoppers, plus a role-gated catalog-management area for Store Administrators. Signs users in via Thunder OIDC and calls ceramics-api for all data. Does not persist any data itself and does not talk to the payment provider directly.
